# Haltom City, TX

> Official municipal website for Haltom City, Texas, providing residents and businesses with government services, utilities management, permits, and civic engagement tools.

Haltom City is a municipality in the Dallas-Fort Worth Metroplex that uses CivicPlus/CivicEngage platforms to deliver online services including utility billing, code enforcement, planning and development, and public meeting information. The site serves as the central hub for resident services, business development, and government transparency.

## Key Topics

- City Council
- Municipal Services
- Utility Billing
- Code Enforcement
- Building Permits
- Economic Development
- Parks & Recreation
- Public Works
- Municipal Court
- Civic Engagement
- Community Events
- Online Payments
- Waste Management
- Planning & Zoning
- City Employment

## Government & Administration

- [Government](https://haltomcitytx.com/27/Government): City government structure, council, boards, commissions, and municipal code
- [Departments](https://haltomcitytx.com/101/Departments): Directory of city departments including Animal Services and Code Enforcement
- [City Council Meeting Summaries](https://haltomcitytx.com/644/City-Council-Meeting-Summaries): Summaries of City Council meetings, decisions, and public transparency
- [Staff Directory](https://haltomcitytx.com/Directory.aspx): City staff directory with contact information and department listings
- [Municipal Court](https://haltomcitytx.com/275/Municipal-Court): Municipal Court procedures, traffic violations, fines, and plea options

## Resident Services & Utilities

- [Residents](https://haltomcitytx.com/31/Residents): Resident portal with city services, utilities, parks, and community resources
- [Utility Billing](https://haltomcitytx.com/378/Utility-Billing): Water billing, rates, payment options, and sewer/trash services
- [Trash / Recycling Services](https://haltomcitytx.com/403/Trash-Recycling-Services): Waste Connections trash pickup schedule and recycling services info
- [How Do I...](https://haltomcitytx.com/9/How-Do-I): How-to guide for city services, permits, payments, and utilities
- [Submit an Issue of Concern](https://haltomcitytx.com/560/Submit): Report code violations, potholes, lost pets, and civic concerns

## Planning, Development & Business

- [Planning & Community Development](https://haltomcitytx.com/277/Planning-Community-Development): Planning, zoning, building permits, and community development coordination
- [Business](https://haltomcitytx.com/35/Business): Economic development resources and business incentives for Haltom City
- [Economic Development](https://haltomcitytx.com/169/Economic-Development): Economic development initiatives, business incentives, and tax abatement

## Community Engagement & Events

- [Calendar](https://haltomcitytx.com/calendar.aspx): Community events calendar and municipal event listings
- [Notify Me](https://haltomcitytx.com/list.aspx): Subscribe to civic alerts, agendas, and government meeting notifications
- [News Flash](https://haltomcitytx.com/CivicAlerts.aspx): Emergency alerts, water safety updates, and EPA compliance notifications

## Employment & Elections

- [Human Resources](https://haltomcitytx.com/267/Human-Resources): City employment opportunities, job applications, and career portal
- [May 2, 2026 Election](https://haltomcitytx.com/658/May-2-2026-Election): Municipal election information for Council Places 3-6 on May 2, 2026
